title: equisetum hyemale f. minus
intro: Equisetum hyemale f. minus, commonly known as Horsetail minus, is a subspecies of the Equisetum hyemale plant, a vascular plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support kidney health and urinary function, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Equisetum hyemale f. minus include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
